article.title: 電商補讀：Coveo收購Anglera，把商品資料補全接入搜尋
article.title_en: Commerce review: Coveo acquires Anglera for product data enrichment
article.summary: Coveo於10月29日宣布收購Anglera，擴充電商商品資料能力。
article.summary_en: Coveo announced its acquisition of Anglera on October 29.
highlights: Anglera從規格文件等來源擷取及標準化資料。
現有客戶繼續使用Anglera；更深整合仍屬計劃。
highlights_en: Anglera extracts and standardizes product attributes.
Existing customers remain on Anglera; deeper integration is planned.
article.why: 商品規格是否完整，會影響搜尋團隊能否準確描述產品差異。
article.why_en: Complete specifications help search teams describe product differences accurately.
article.next_step: 先抽查高價值商品的尺寸、材質及相容性資料與來源。
article.next_step_en: Audit dimensions, materials, compatibility and their sources for priority products.
article.detail: 這宗收購把商品資料補全工具加入Coveo的商務服務。按公司描述，Anglera會從規格表、PDF及圖片等來源擷取屬性，按客戶目錄要求整理，並保留來源參考。Coveo Commerce客戶將可透過附加服務使用相關能力。交易條款未公開，結合搜尋行為與資料補全的更深整合仍待實現；公告中的成效案例不代表其他零售商可獲相同結果。
article.detail_en: Anglera retains source references while extracting attributes from specifications, PDFs and images. Coveo says enrichment will be an add-on for Commerce customers. Transaction terms were undisclosed. Planned integration and vendor case results do not establish outcomes for other retailers.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
